decisions.briefing: Tech stocks led today (NASDAQ +1.1%) while the S&P 500 barely moved (+0.3%), so the day reads as neutral rather than a clear risk-on day. Cash is $345.88, which is below the $500 buy threshold, and all 7 positions are inside their stop-loss and profit-target ranges. Following our rule of not forcing buys on neutral days, we are holding all positions and keeping the cash until a stronger risk-on signal appears.

market_education.summary_en: Technology and growth stocks outpaced the broader market today, with the NASDAQ up 1.1% against a modest 0.3% gain for the S&P 500. That gap suggests buyers favored higher-growth names such as quantum computing, space and crypto-mining stocks, many of which show bullish MACD crossovers in today's screen. No news headlines came with today's data, so this explanation rests on index moves and technical signals rather than on specific news events.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日科技及成長股表現明顯跑贏大市，納斯達克指數上升1.1%，標普500指數僅微升0.3%。兩者表現分化，反映資金偏好量子運算、太空及加密貨幣挖礦等高增長板塊，今日篩選名單中不少相關股份均出現MACD黃金交叉等技術性買入訊號。由於今日未有附帶新聞標題，以上分析僅根據指數走勢及技術指標，並非針對個別新聞事件。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder is cash an investor keeps on hand so they can act when a good opportunity comes along. Today our cash ($345.88) is below the minimum we need to open a sensible new position, and the market signal is only neutral, so we save it instead of spending it on a weak setup. Waiting for a clear risk-on day to use dry powder usually works better than buying just to stay fully invested.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指投資者手上保留的現金，留待真正的好機會出現時出手。今日組合現金僅約345.88美元，未達開設新倉的最低門檻，加上大市訊號中性，因此選擇按兵不動，不會勉強追入質素一般的機會。與其為求滿倉而倉促入市，耐心等待明確的風險偏好（Risk-On）時機再出擊，往往更為穩健。
